name: Install Linux
description: Writes a raw disk image, such as a distribution's cloud image, and a cloud-init seed that names the machine, then runs a script in the installed Linux.

steps.userData:
#cloud-config
# Every viewer of DDT can read this. Put in public keys, and passwords only hashed.
# "default" is the image's own user, such as ubuntu or debian. The keys below are for it.
users:
  - default
# ssh_authorized_keys:
#   - ssh-ed25519 AAAA... name@example.org
steps.name: Write the cloud-init seed

steps.script:
# Runs as root in the installed Linux, once cloud-init has finished. Replace it with what the machine needs.
echo "The run goes on in $(uname -sr) on $(hostname), as $(id -un)."
steps.name: Say where the run goes on
